mentions.name: Venery
mentions.description: A web game where players vote on what to call groups of non-animal things (collective nouns beyond terms of venery, e.g. roses, snowflakes, lawyers). Votes are ranked with simple ELO scoring, an endless mode is always available, and a daily contest lets players compete Wordle-style.
mentions.problem: There are no established terms of venery for groups of non-animal things like roses, snowflakes, or lawyers, so the answers are put to a community vote.
mentions.source_excerpt:
What do you call a group of Roses, or Snowflakes, or Lawyers?

Well, I couldn't figure it out, so I put it to a vote.

Simple ELO scoring, Endless mode is always on, and there is a Daily Contest for you to compete in (Wordle for wordsmiths, I guess).
